problem_statement: When a DNS name label encoded in a message contains an embedded null character (\0) within the declared label length, ReadLabel accepts the label and returns success instead of reporting a parse error. Labels with null characters at the start, middle, or end of the label bytes should be rejected as malformed. A malformed DNS label containing a null character is silently accepted, which can cause incorrect name parsing or security issues.
